job.job_description:
We are seeking a Full-Stack Developer to design and develop both front-end and back-end components of web applications.
Responsibilities:
Develop robust, scalable web applications using front-end and back-end technologies.
Work with UI/UX teams to implement responsive interfaces.
Build and consume APIs for seamless application functionality.
Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and security.
Manage databases, servers, and deployment pipelines.
Conduct testing, debugging, and code reviews.
Maintain documentation and follow agile development practices.
Skills:
Expertise in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React/Angular/Vue.
Backend experience with Node.js, Python, or Java.
Knowledge of databases (MySQL, goDB).
Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, Git.
API integration and cloud hosting knowledge.
Educational Qualification:
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or related field.
Certifications in JavaScript frameworks, Cloud Computing, Full-Stack Development Bootcamp are an added advantage.
